semantic_assessment: Directly reread all650 source/old/new rows and the separate Japanese headline. Western changes retain pitch-vs-timbre, physical fret-vs-fret-space, alternating-thumb/chord-change pedagogy and proper titles; retained soft-length warnings are not mechanically truncated.

Changed Hebrew beat-one wording is ordinal and Hebrew/Persian isolates are balanced. Persian Latin-note and attribution spans remain present; all altered lesson numeric groups and accidentals match the previous target.

Croatian ti, Romanian tu, Turkish sen and Slovenian ti changes retain plural musical objects and gender-neutral user status where appropriate. Purchase periods, cancellation path, free-tier instruments, privacy promises and numeric placeholders survive.

All five multi-proposal rows are resolved by exact recorded target provenance: Russian alternating-thumb refinement, Croatian nominative-title template, Turkish sitar common-convention noun, Turkish in-two-days correction, Slovenian nominative-title template. Four Slovenian first-pass refinements are represented in frozen reviewed targets.

Four new source-bound identities are only Russian/Korean encoded mnemonic headings. Directly reread localized companion cards L1028012093 and L171dc8ec17 plus subsequent word-referent quiz explanations: English initials encode staff letters and complete localized meaning glosses remain available. No prior registry approvals were reattributed or expanded.

Held Zulu main-theme proposal and three Slovenian cello catalogue/photo/literal renamings remain unchanged. Čelo is a legitimate musical short form; the earlier forehead-only rationale is superseded by the separate addendum cross-review. Achievement violončela agrees with the reviewed course label.

Case-safe course-name label templates avoid inflecting supplied nominative titles; Chinese 演奏 covers bowed/plucked performance. The current first-person/formal registers outside the selected register locales remain intact.

Japanese 音合わせ is an appropriate descriptive tuning synonym in this exact onboarding sentence; sequence, speed claim, invitation and explicit newline remain intact. Pinned Tune and tuner controls are not changed by this prose exception.
